note: SmolVLA resizes each image to fit 512 × 512 keeping its aspect ratio and pads with zeros on the LEFT and TOP (LeRobot's resize_with_pad; π0 in openpi pads evenly instead), so a 4:3 image sits in the lower part of the square. The vision encoder takes 16 px patches of the 512 px image and a pixel shuffle (scale_factor 4) leaves 64 visual tokens per frame. The base checkpoint's config lists three camera inputs (camera1-3, recorded at 256 × 256 and then resized); the paper's SO100 and SO101 rigs use two. No inference time is stated: the paper reports task completion times only. Model card licence Apache-2.0. DexVantage bundles these figures only, not the model.

input_resolution.quote: "resize_imgs_with_padding": [512, 512]; the paper: "Training is performed after resizing the images to 512×512, for consistency with the VLM input size."

crop_rule.quote: vla_utils.resize_with_pad: "Resize a (b, c, h, w) image without distortion, padding on the LEFT and TOP. This is the smolvla/xvla convention." (pad_value=0)

tokens_per_image.quote: "We use the global image only, in addition to a pixel shuffle operation, limiting the visual tokens to 64 per frame."

n_cameras.quote: config.json input_features observation.images.camera1, camera2, camera3, "empty_cameras": 0; the paper: "For SO100, we use top and wrist cameras, where for SO101 we use top and side cameras."

action_chunk.quote: "chunk_size": 50; the paper: "output chunks of n=50 actions"

temporal_ensemble_m.quote: Not stated: asynchronous inference "aggregate[s] overlaps (if any)" with no weighting given.

inference_ms.quote: Not stated (task completion: asynchronous 9.7 s, synchronous 13.75 s).

control_hz.quote: "With a real-world frame-rate of 30 frames per second, Δt=33 ms."
